results.title: Days after picking up new instruments, these Indigenous youths wrote their own song
results.description: The Community Arts Mentorship Program hosted a week-long program for young Indigenous musicians aged 11 to 18 at Saskatoon's White Buffalo Youth Lodge. Students took away more than just a new song.
